comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Let's see. There's specifics on the fleet:

uwomarcos.blogspot.com/2014/08/plundering-rare-items-consumables-and.html

You sound like you know about that already, though. I also found a map on a Japanese blog; maybe it'd help to have approximate locations of where to hunt?

blog.goo.ne.jp/tomo19980402/e/531e0a9db4bd6ecb07e7356ed72e35b8

You may already have known about that too. Obviously the Oxford skill Rare Item Plunder is a necessity for item plundering... Hmm. Can't think of anything else, and no other search results seemed promising. Well, other than this:

roserougedol.blog.fc2.com/blog-date-20121213.html

Please note that there's more than one kind of Christmas Ticket item, and seemingly no way to tell them apart from one another. The event on the third link seems different from our most recent Christmas event that give out such tickets, so even that isn't necessarily a lead.

It really does seem like a very hard to find item; I wish you well in your item hunting. Cheers, and favorable, MA-item plundering to you.
